name: Kit 7 — Competitor Conquest (Bid On Rivals, Monitor & Strike)

nodes.name: Daily 5am Cron
nodes.notes: Runs daily at 5am to check competitor activity and optimise conquest campaigns

nodes.name: Load Competitor List
nodes.notes: Loads competitor names, websites, GBP URLs, and ad spend estimates

nodes.name: Semrush — Competitor Keyword Check
nodes.notes: Pulls competitor's top organic keywords, rankings, and estimated traffic. Identifies keyword gaps.

nodes.name: SERP — Check Competitor Brand Results
nodes.notes: Checks competitor's brand SERP. If OUR ad is not showing above them, conquest campaign needs update.

nodes.name: Check Competitor GBP Reviews
nodes.notes: Monitors competitor review count and rating. Alerts when they drop a rating or get negative reviews — prime time to increase ad spend.

values.content:
=You are a competitive Google Ads strategist.

Our business: {{ $('load-config').item.json.business_name }}
Industry: {{ $('load-config').item.json.industry }}
City: {{ $('load-config').item.json.city }}

Competitor: {{ $json.competitor_name }}
Competitor website: {{ $json.website }}
Competitor current rating: {{ $json.rating }} ({{ $json.user_ratings_total }} reviews)
Competitor top keywords: {{ JSON.stringify($('semrush-competitor').item.json, null, 2) }}

Our current Google Ads conquest campaign status: {{ $json.conquest_campaign_status }}

Generate:

1. conquest_ad_headlines: 10 Google Ads headlines (30 chars max each) that appear when someone searches the competitor's name. Should be comparative without being disparaging. Emphasise our strengths (speed, guarantee, price, reviews).

2. conquest_ad_descriptions: 5 Google Ads descriptions (90 chars max each)

3. conquest_landing_page_brief: Brief for a dedicated comparison landing page '[us] vs [competitor]'. Include:
   - Page title (SEO-optimised)
   - H1
   - Comparison table (5 key differentiators)
   - 3 customer testimonials placeholders
   - FAQ (5 questions people ask when choosing between these two)
   - Strong CTA

4. competitor_weakness_analysis: Based on their reviews and keywords, what are their top 3 weaknesses we should highlight?

5. bid_recommendation: Should we increase/decrease/maintain conquest bid today? Reasoning (e.g. 'competitor dropped from 4.8 to 4.3 stars — increase bid 30% to capture their dissatisfied leads').

6. alert_needed: true/false — Should owner be alerted about a significant competitor change?
7. alert_message: If yes, what should the WhatsApp say?

Return as JSON.

nodes.name: Claude — Conquest Strategy & Ad Copy
nodes.notes: Claude analyses competitor weaknesses and generates conquest ad copy + landing page brief

nodes.name: Update Google Ads Conquest Creative
nodes.notes: Updates Google Ads responsive search ad for competitor conquest campaign with fresh Claude-generated copy

nodes.name: WhatsApp — Competitor Alert
nodes.notes: Alerts owner when a significant competitor change is detected (rating drop, new ad, price change)

nodes.name: Log Competitor Data
nodes.notes: Tracks competitor metrics over time for trend analysis

meta.description: Daily competitor monitoring and conquest campaign management. Checks competitor GBP ratings, keywords, and ad spend. Claude generates fresh conquest ad copy targeting competitor brand searches. Alerts owner when competitors drop in rating or make significant moves.
